rows.quote: Summary‐level data on these outcomes were obtained from the UK Biobank and FinnGen R9 release.
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the release: FinnGen R9; the other passages repeat R9 and none conflicts.
UK Biobank GWAS by the Lee Lab (leelabsg.org/resources) with no release, imputation panel, sample size or citation; two dictionary rows are Lee lab UK Biobank resources and nothing separates them.

rows.quote: The discovery analysis was based on the deCODE protein genetic database that assessed genetic variants' associations with 4719 unique plasma proteins measured in 35 559 Icelanders. 27 We further used two replication data sources from the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB‐PPP) where 2923 unique proteins were profiled in 54 219 participants 28 as well as from the Fenland study where genetic associations were calculated for 4775 proteins in 10 708 Caucasian. 29 Both the deCODE and Fenland studies profiled blood protein data using the SomaScan version 4 assay (SomaLogic) while the UKB‐PPP used Olink Explore 3072 PEA.
rows.reference_quote: Pietzner M, Wheeler E, Carrasco‐Zanini J, et al. Mapping the proteo‐genomic convergence of human diseases. Science. 2021;374(6569):eabj1541.
rows.coder_note: The Fenland data (4775 proteins, 10 708 participants, SomaScan version 4) are attributed to reference 29, whose DOI 10.1126/science.abj1541 is that of the Pietzner 2021 row alone.
Reference 28 (Sun 2023) has four dictionary rows; the only attribute given, 54 219 participants, is the sample size of none of them, and no ancestry or subcohort is stated.
